title: Bound the signed BIT invoice for all fresh ninth-axis assignments
body:
For the stated fresh ninth-axis model, directed cross-rank inequalities apply to all 2^111 choices of head or body position, with freely changed local pulse expressions and the old rank bins. After charging every productive helper and all caller terms, the affine upper bound on the signed change is below −78.85 at both 0.003879928046156 and 0.003879929046155. A separate simultaneous cochart cut sweep has directed gain upper at most 1.116e−25, insufficient to pay the incumbent deficit.

Pinned #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. This changes the ambient/caller axis assignment, beyond #7881 and #7900. Both cold replays passed with exact outward pricing, 112 rank controls, and changed-shear, graph and unary-cost rejection. Retained source authors credited. OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

Change the boundary encoder or decoder and helper-rank contract, use coupled axes or change paid occurrence geometry with full financing.
